requirements.quote: Provide legal/tax registration; the site's valid ISO 9001 certificate; two comparable programmes delivered in the last five years; three references; named team/capacity plan; and signed prices/deviations. Disclose insolvency, material litigation and conflicts of interest.
requirements.text: Submit legal/tax registration, ISO 9001 certificate, program examples, references, team plan, signed prices, and disclose legal issues.

requirements.quote: Unresolved mandatory technical departures, refusal of traceability/secure provisioning or an incomplete price basis are nonresponsive.
requirements.text: Ensure no unresolved technical departures, refusal of traceability, or incomplete price basis.

requirements.quote: Material requirement changes require an addendum to all bidders; ambiguities may be clarified individually.
requirements.text: Material requirement changes must be communicated to all bidders; ambiguities can be clarified individually.

requirements.quote: Technical design and compliance: 30 - Requirement coverage; design rationale; thermal/security maturity; verification quality.
requirements.text: Provide technical design and compliance details, including requirement coverage, design rationale, and verification quality.

requirements.quote: Quality and manufacturing capability: 20 - Site/process controls, audit results, test coverage, traceability and comparable outcomes.
requirements.text: Demonstrate quality and manufacturing capability, including site controls, audits, and traceability.

requirements.quote: Programme and supply-chain readiness: 15 - Credible gate schedule, resourcing, component risk, continuity and capacity.
requirements.text: Show program and supply-chain readiness, including schedule, resources, and risk management.

requirements.quote: Commercial value: 25 - TEC comparison using Section 11.1; completeness of assumptions and price validity.
requirements.text: Provide commercial value assessment, including TEC comparison and price validity.

requirements.quote: Service and contract acceptance: 10 - Warranty/repair capability, support commitments, transfer rights and contract departures.
requirements.text: Detail service and contract acceptance, including warranty, support, and contract terms.

requirements.quote: Non-price ratings: 0 absent; 1 major weakness; 2 partly credible; 3 meets; 4 evidenced advantage; 5 exceptional evidenced advantage.
requirements.text: Understand the non-price rating scale from 0 to 5 based on evidence and credibility.

requirements.quote: Qualify with 52.5/75 non-price points and 18/30 technical points.
requirements.text: Achieve at least 52.5/75 non-price points and 18/30 technical points to qualify.

requirements.quote: Price points = 25 x lowest eligible TEC / bidder TEC. Highest total is preferred subject to audit, references and contract.
requirements.text: Price points are calculated based on TEC; highest total score is preferred.

requirements.quote: Ties: higher technical score, then lower TEC.
requirements.text: In case of ties, higher technical score and lower TEC are preferred.

requirements.quote: Volume A Technical: Offer and site profile; compliance matrix; architecture/BOM risks; NPI schedule; test/quality plans; security and service approach.
requirements.text: Include technical offer, compliance matrix, risks, schedule, and plans in Volume A.

requirements.quote: Volume B Commercial: P01-P12; cost workbook; annual price breakdown; taxes/freight/duties; payment acceptance; contract redlines; TEC.
requirements.text: Include cost workbook, price breakdown, taxes, payment terms, and TEC in Volume B.

requirements.quote: Volume C Forms and evidence: Forms A-C; addenda; deviations; ISO certificate; insurance commitment; references; subcontractors; background IP.
requirements.text: Include forms, addenda, ISO certificate, insurance, references, and IP in Volume C.

requirements.quote: Cross-reference evidence by page. Unsupported marketing claims receive no credit.
requirements.text: Cross-reference evidence by page; unsupported claims are not credited.

requirements.quote: State named resources, capacity and dependencies; generic capability material does not replace the response matrix.
requirements.text: Provide named resources, capacity, and dependencies; avoid generic material.
